$comment: Deterministic, hand-curated recommendations for the lab builder wizard. Nothing here is scored by a model, so every pre-selected topic can show the exact reason it was chosen. `levels` lists the topics that make up a lab at each level (the new depth that level adds; prerequisites are added automatically, so a level 200 lab still includes the level 100 foundations it depends on). `verticals` and `departments` add topics that matter to that industry or team; they are recommended only at or below the chosen level, and every one stays selectable at any level. Features that do not apply to the chosen products (or, for Copilot Studio, the chosen harness) are ignored, so one list serves every product combination and every harness. Every id must exist in the catalog (validateRecommendations enforces this).

healthcare.why: Healthcare labs handle patient data, so identity, safety, and data policy matter early, and Copilot access to protected health information must be limited and auditable.

retail.why: Retail scenarios connect storefront and customer systems, and process documents such as invoices and receipts.

financial-services.why: Financial services labs need strong identity and data controls, and evidence of who used Copilot and which data it touched.

manufacturing.why: Manufacturing scenarios reach plant and ERP systems, often on-premises, and handle paperwork.

energy-resources.why: Energy operations rely on ERP and on-premises operational data, and handle field and compliance paperwork.

education.why: Education scenarios center on documents, safe responses, and Teams.

nonprofit.why: Nonprofits track supporters and programs in CRM and shared documents.

it.why: IT teams work in ticketing systems, automate runbooks, administer who can use which agents, and support users who cannot reach Copilot.

customer-service.why: Customer service needs case systems and customer-facing channels.

sales.why: Sales teams live in CRM and product material.

marketing.why: Marketing content needs brand-safe, grounded answers, and reusable prompts.

finance.why: Finance works in ERP, processes invoices, and needs policy controls and approvals.

hr.why: HR answers come from policy documents and involve private information.

legal.why: Legal teams need safe responses, data policy, controlled change, and control over which content Copilot can reach and process.

executives.why: Executives look for measurable outcomes, quality, adoption, and cost.

operations.why: Operations teams automate multi-step processes, organize documents, and track results.

communications.why: Communications teams publish to employees and need safe wording.

sustainability.why: Sustainability reporting draws on structured data and trends.

accessibility.why: Accessibility work needs checked, consistent responses.
